label: Transformed into historical Absolute Spirit coming to self-consciousness
description: G.W.F. Hegel took up the concept of "The Absolute Self-Positing Ego (Ich)" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "The Absolute Self-Positing Ego (Ich)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the German Idealism & Romanticism.
